newsitem.title: USA: ARV Assisted Living completes acquisition.
newsitem.headline: ARV Assisted Living completes acquisition.

text.p: ARV Assisted Living Inc said Thursday it has completed its acquisition of SynCare Inc, a health services provider of physical, occupational and speech therapies primarily in assisted living facilities.

The purchase price was $1,170,764. ARV issued 85,146 new shares to SynCare's founders, 50 percent of which are subject to a three year earn-out agreement. The deal valued ARV's shares at roughly $13.75 a share.

SynCare operates under the trade name of Geri Care and provides services in more than 40 assisted living facilities. SynCare had gross revenue of about $4.8 million in its fiscal year ended June 30, 1996, when operations were limited to California. ARV said it expects to grow SynCare's business by expanding outside of California.
